name: Webform Newsletter2Go
description: Integrates Webform submissions with the Newsletter2Go (Brevo) email-marketing service.
project_description:
This module integrates Newsletter2Go  with Drupal Webform  module.

 It currently supports the Double Opt-in Email Sign-Up Form .

 Drupal 10 Installation and configuration 
 This module requires the following modules: 

 
 Webform 
 Newsletter2Go user account 
 
 Installing: 

 
 The recommended way to install this module is via Composer. 
 
 Configuration: 

 
 Configure double opt-in email sign-up form on your newsletter2go account ( See video ). 
 Install Webform Newsletter2Go module. 
 Add credentials - /admin/config/services/newsletter2go 
 Create new webform. Use the same field names as on double opt-in form. 
 Add " Newsletter2Go double opt-in form " handler to your webform. 
 - Add Form ID, you can find needed form_id on this page - https://ui.newsletter2go.com/forms 

 - Select Submission data, the "email" field is required for double opt-in, make sure that it is checked.
